# Context packet: build a bounded evidence packer

Implement `context-packet.js`, using Node.js builtins only. A factory needs to
choose complete context sections without silently losing required evidence.
This is a deterministic byte-budget packer, not a tokenizer or a claim about
optimal model context. Export synchronous `packContext(sections, maxBytes)`.

Validate the entire input before packing, even when the budget is zero or a
section would be omitted. `maxBytes` is a nonnegative safe integer. `sections`
is a dense array of non-null, non-array objects; missing array slots are invalid.
Each object has required fields:

```
{id: NONEMPTY_STRING, text: STRING, priority: NONNEGATIVE_SAFE_INTEGER,
 required: BOOLEAN}
```

IDs are unique exact strings, including case. Spaces, Unicode, newlines, NUL
and names such as `__proto__` are valid IDs. Unknown object fields are ignored.
Do not coerce values. Invalid input throws an Error. Do not mutate inputs.

The exact serialized frame for one section is:

```
'### ' + JSON.stringify(section.id) + '\n' + section.text + '\n'
```

Its cost is `Buffer.byteLength(frame, 'utf8')`, including the framing and both
newlines. Frames are indivisible. Do not shorten text, normalize newlines,
invent references, or substitute character count for UTF-8 byte count.

1. Include all required sections first, in their original input order. Ignore
   their priority when ordering them. If their combined cost exceeds maxBytes,
   throw an Error instead of returning a partial required set.
2. Visit optional sections by descending priority, breaking ties by original
   input order. Include a section if its entire frame fits the remaining
   budget. Otherwise skip it and continue trying later sections.
3. Output sections in that inclusion order. Report omitted optional IDs in
   original input order, not priority order.

Return exactly:

```
{text: CONCATENATED_FRAMES, bytes: UTF8_BYTE_COUNT,
 included: [ID_IN_OUTPUT_ORDER], omitted: [ID_IN_INPUT_ORDER]}
```

An empty input returns `{text:'',bytes:0,included:[],omitted:[]}` for any valid
budget. Exact fits are allowed. Neither the source text nor the returned
framing is trimmed.

CLI: `node context-packet.js INPUT_JSON_FILE`. The UTF-8 JSON file contains
`{sections, maxBytes}`; extra fields are ignored. Exactly one argument is
required. Success prints exactly one result JSON plus newline, exits 0 and
has no stderr. Invalid arguments, unreadable files, invalid JSON or API input,
and insufficient required-section budget exit 2, with nonempty stderr and no
stdout. Importing the module must not run the CLI.

Do not add dependencies or edit `package.json` or existing public tests. You
may add tests. Verification runs in a read-only workspace: any test fixtures
must be created beneath `os.tmpdir()` and removed afterward. Run `npm test`
before finishing. Hidden acceptance uses this same contract with other values.

29: }

31: export function packContext(sections, maxBytes) {
32:   if (!isNonNegativeSafeInteger(maxBytes)) {
33:     throw new Error('maxBytes must be a nonnegative safe integer');
34:   }
35:   if (!Array.isArray(sections)) {
36:     throw new Error('sections must be an array');
37:   }
38:   const seenIds = new Set();
39:   for (let i = 0; i < sections.length; i++) {
40:     const section = sections[i];
41:     if (section === undefined) {
42:       throw new Error(`sections must be dense: missing entry at index ${i}`);
43:     }
44:     assertSection(section, i);
45:     const id = section.id;
46:     if (seenIds.has(id)) {
47:       throw new Error(`duplicate section id: ${id}`);
48:     }
49:     seenIds.add(id);
50:   }
51: 
52:   const requiredEntries = [];
53:   const optionalEntries = [];
54:   for (let i = 0; i < sections.length; i++) {
55:     const section = sections[i];
56:     const frame = '### ' + JSON.stringify(section.id) + '\n' + section.text + '\n';
57:     const entry = {
58:       id: section.id,
59:       frame,
60:       cost: Buffer.byteLength(frame, 'utf8'),
61:       index: i,
62:       priority: section.priority,
63:     };
64:     (section.required ? requiredEntries : optionalEntries).push(entry);
65:   }
66: 
67:   const requiredCost = requiredEntries.reduce((sum, entry) => sum + entry.cost, 0);
68:   if (requiredCost > maxBytes) {
69:     throw new Error('required sections exceed maxBytes');
70:   }
71: 
72:   let remaining = maxBytes - requiredCost;
73:   const orderedOptionals = [...optionalEntries].sort(
74:     (a, b) => b.priority - a.priority || a.index - b.index,
75:   );
76:   const includedEntries = [...requiredEntries];
77:   const includedIds = new Set();
78:   for (const entry of orderedOptionals) {
79:     if (entry.cost <= remaining) {

19:   assert.deepEqual(packContext([], Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER).bytes, 0);
20: });
21: 
22: test('sections must be a dense array of plain objects', () => {
23:   for (const bad of [null, undefined, 42, 'x', {}, new Set()]) {
24:     assert.throws(() => packContext(bad, 10), Error);
25:   }
26:   assert.throws(() => packContext(new Array(2), 10), Error);
27:   assert.throws(() => packContext([undefined], 10), Error);
28:   const sparse = [];
29:   sparse[2] = section('a', 'a');
30:   assert.throws(() => packContext(sparse, 10), Error);
31:   for (const bad of [null, 42, 's', [], {}]) {
32:     assert.throws(() => packContext([bad], 10), Error);
33:   }
34:   assert.throws(() => packContext([[section('a', 'a')]], 10), Error);
35:   assert.deepEqual(packContext([], 5).included, []);
36: });
37: 
38: test('field validation is strict and uncoerced', () => {
39:   const cases = [
40:     [{text: 't', priority: 0, required: false}], // missing id
41:     [{id: '', text: 't', priority: 0, required: false}],
42:     [{id: 7, text: 't', priority: 0, required: false}],
43:     [{id: null, text: 't', priority: 0, required: false}],
44:     [{id: 'a', priority: 0, required: false}], // missing text
45:     [{id: 'a', text: 3, priority: 0, required: false}],
46:     [{id: 'a', text: null, priority: 0, required: false}],
47:     [{id: 'a', text: 't', required: false}], // missing priority
48:     [{id: 'a', text: 't', priority: -1, required: false}],
49:     [{id: 'a', text: 't', priority: 1.5, required: false}],
50:     [{id: 'a', text: 't', priority: Infinity, required: false}],
51:     [{id: 'a', text: 't', priority: '5', required: false}],
52:     [{id: 'a', text: 't', priority: NaN, required: false}],
53:     [{id: 'a', text: 't', priority: 0}], // missing required
54:     [{id: 'a', text: 't', priority: 0, required: 'yes'}],
55:     [{id: 'a', text: 't', priority: 0, required: 1}],
56:     [{id: 'a', text: 't', priority: 0, required: null}],
57:   ];
58:   for (const bad of cases) {
59:     assert.throws(() => packContext(bad, 100), Error, JSON.stringify(bad));
60:   }
61:   assert.doesNotThrow(() => packContext([{id: 'a', text: 't', priority: 0, required: false, extra: 1}], 100));
62:   assert.doesNotThrow(() => packContext([Object.assign(Object.create(null), {id: 'a', text: 't', priority: 0, required: false})], 100));
63: });
64: 
65: test('ids are unique exact strings; __proto__, spaces, unicode, NUL are valid', () => {
66:   assert.throws(() => packContext([section('A', 'a'), section('A', 'b')], 100), Error);
67:   assert.throws(() => packContext([section('x', 'a'), section('x', 'b', 1, true)], 0), Error);
68:   const ok = packContext(
69:     [
70:       section('__proto__', 'p'),
71:       section('  spaced  ', 's'),
72:       section('uni\u0000code', 'n'),
73:       section('A', 'a'),
74:       section('a', 'b'),
75:     ],
76:     1000,
77:   );
78:   assert.deepEqual(ok.included, ['__proto__', '  spaced  ', 'uni\u0000code', 'A', 'a']);
79:   assert.ok(ok.text.includes(frameOf('__proto__', 'p')));
80:   assert.ok(ok.text.includes(frameOf('uni\u0000code', 'n')));
81: });
82: 
83: test('validation runs even when budget is zero or entries would be omitted', () => {
84:   assert.throws(() => packContext([section('a', 'x'), section('a', 'y')], 0), Error);
85:   assert.throws(() => packContext([section('a', 'x'), {id: 'b', text: 9, priority: 0, required: false}], 0), Error);
86:   assert.throws(() => packContext([section('a', 'x', 0, true), section('b', 'y')], 0), Error);
87: });
88: 
89: test('frames are exact and bytes are UTF-8', () => {
90:   const res = packContext([section('id"q', 'héllo\nworld', 0, true)], 1000);
91:   assert.equal(res.text, '### "id\\"q"\nhéllo\nworld\n');
92:   assert.equal(res.bytes, Buffer.byteLength(res.text, 'utf8'));
93:   assert.equal(res.bytes, costOf('id"q', 'héllo\nworld'));
94:   assert.deepEqual(res.included, ['id"q']);
95:   assert.deepEqual(res.omitted, []);
96: });
97: 
98: test('required sections come first in input order; overflow throws', () => {
99:   const sections = [section('opt', 'z', 99), section('r2', 'bb', 1, true), section('r1', 'a', 5, true)];
100:   const reqCost = costOf('r2', 'bb') + costOf('r1', 'a');
101:   const cost = reqCost + costOf('opt', 'z');
102:   const res = packContext(sections, cost);
103:   assert.equal(res.text, frameOf('r2', 'bb') + frameOf('r1', 'a') + frameOf('opt', 'z'));
104:   assert.deepEqual(res.included, ['r2', 'r1', 'opt']);
105:   assert.deepEqual(res.omitted, []);
106:   assert.throws(() => packContext(sections, reqCost - 1), Error);
107:   const tight = packContext(sections, reqCost);
108:   assert.deepEqual(tight.included, ['r2', 'r1']);
109:   assert.deepEqual(tight.omitted, ['opt']);
110:   assert.equal(tight.bytes, reqCost);
111: });
112: 
113: test('optionals: priority desc, tie by input order, skip instead of stop', () => {
114:   const sections = [
115:     section('low', 'x', 1),
116:     section('high', 'x', 5),
117:     section('mid-a', 'x', 3),
118:     section('mid-b', 'x', 3),
119:     section('huge', 'x'.repeat(500), 4),
120:   ];
121:   const c = {
122:     low: costOf('low', 'x'),
123:     high: costOf('high', 'x'),
124:     midA: costOf('mid-a', 'x'),
125:     midB: costOf('mid-b', 'x'),
126:     huge: costOf('huge', 'x'.repeat(500)),
127:   };
128:   const res = packContext(sections, c.low + c.high + c.midA + c.midB);
129:   assert.deepEqual(res.included, ['high', 'mid-a', 'mid-b', 'low']);
130:   assert.deepEqual(res.omitted, ['huge']);
131:   assert.equal(res.bytes, c.low + c.high + c.midA + c.midB);
132:   const tie = packContext(
133:     [section('t2', 'y', 7), section('t1', 'y', 7), section('t0', 'y', 8)],
134:     costOf('t0', 'y') + costOf('t1', 'y') + costOf('t2', 'y'),
135:   );
136:   assert.deepEqual(tie.included, ['t0', 't2', 't1']);
137:   const skip = packContext(sections, c.high + c.midA);
138:   assert.deepEqual(skip.included, ['high', 'mid-a']);
139:   assert.deepEqual(skip.omitted, ['low', 'mid-b', 'huge']);
140: });
141: 
142: test('omitted ids are reported in input order', () => {
143:   const sections = [section('a', 'x', 1), section('b', 'x', 9), section('c', 'x', 5), section('d', 'x', 9)];
144:   const res = packContext(sections, costOf('x', 'x') * 2);
145:   assert.deepEqual(res.included, ['b', 'd']);
146:   assert.deepEqual(res.omitted, ['a', 'c']);
147: });
148: 
149: test('input is not mutated', () => {
150:   const sections = [
151:     {id: 'a', text: 't', priority: 2, required: false, note: {deep: [1, 2]}},
152:     section('b', 'u', 0, true),
153:   ];
154:   const snapshot = JSON.stringify(sections);
155:   packContext(sections, 1000);
156:   assert.equal(JSON.stringify(sections), snapshot);
157:   assert.equal(Object.keys(sections[0]).length, 5);
158: });
159: 
160: const CLI = fileURLToPath(new URL('../context-packet.js', import.meta.url));
161: 
162: function runCli(args) {
163:   return spawnSync(process.execPath, [CLI, ...args], {encoding: 'utf8'});
164: }
165: 
166: test('CLI success prints exactly one JSON line and exits 0', () => {
167:   const dir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'context-packet-'));
168:   try {
169:     const file = join(dir, 'input.json');
170:     writeFileSync(file, JSON.stringify({
171:       extra: true,
172:       sections: [section('s1', 'one', 1), section('s2', 'two', 2, true)],
173:       maxBytes: 10000,
174:     }), 'utf8');
175:     const res = runCli([file]);
176:     assert.equal(res.status, 0);
177:     assert.equal(res.stderr, '');
178:     const lines = res.stdout.split('\n');
179:     assert.deepEqual(lines.slice(-1), ['']);
180:     assert.equal(lines.length, 2);
181:     const parsed = JSON.parse(res.stdout);
182:     assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(parsed), ['text', 'bytes', 'included', 'omitted']);
183:     assert.equal(parsed.text, frameOf('s2', 'two') + frameOf('s1', 'one'));
184:     assert.equal(parsed.bytes, parsed.text.length);
185:     assert.deepEqual(parsed.included, ['s2', 's1']);
186:     assert.deepEqual(parsed.omitted, []);
187:   } finally {
188:     rmSync(dir, {recursive: true, force: true});
189:   }
190: });
191: 
192: test('CLI empty sections with zero budget succeeds', () => {
193:   const dir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'context-packet-'));
194:   try {
195:     const file = join(dir, 'empty.json');
196:     writeFileSync(file, '{"sections":[],"maxBytes":0}', 'utf8');
197:     const res = runCli([file]);
198:     assert.equal(res.status, 0);
199:     assert.equal(res.stderr, '');
200:     assert.equal(res.stdout, JSON.stringify({text: '', bytes: 0, included: [], omitted: []}) + '\n');
201:   } finally {
202:     rmSync(dir, {recursive: true, force: true});
203:   }
204: });
205: 
206: test('CLI failure modes exit 2 with stderr and no stdout', () => {
207:   const dir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'context-packet-'));
208:   try {
209:     const write = (name, content) => {
210:       const file = join(dir, name);
211:       writeFileSync(file, content, 'utf8');
212:       return file;
213:     };
214:     const cases = [
215:       [], // no args
216:       [write('ok.json', '{"sections":[],"maxBytes":0}'), 'extra-arg'], // two args
217:       [join(dir, 'missing.json')], // unreadable file
218:       [write('bad.json', '{not json')], // invalid JSON
219:       [write('array.json', '[1,2,3]')], // top-level not an object
220:       [write('string.json', '"hi"')], // top-level not an object
221:       [write('maxstr.json', '{"sections":[],"maxBytes":"10"}')], // API input invalid
222:       [write('sparse.json', '{"sections":[null],"maxBytes":10}')], // API input invalid
223:       [write('dup.json', '{"sections":[{"id":"a","text":"t","priority":0,"required":false},{"id":"a","text":"t","priority":0,"required":false}],"maxBytes":10}')],
224:       [write('overflow.json', '{"sections":[{"id":"a","text":"t","priority":0,"required":true}],"maxBytes":0}')],
225:     ];
226:     for (const args of cases) {
227:       const res = runCli(args);
228:       assert.equal(res.status, 2, JSON.stringify(args));
229:       assert.ok(res.stderr.length > 0, 'stderr must be nonempty for ' + JSON.stringify(args));
230:       assert.equal(res.stdout, '', 'stdout must be empty for ' + JSON.stringify(args));
231:     }
232:   } finally {
233:     rmSync(dir, {recursive: true, force: true});
234:   }
235: });
236: 
237: test('importing the module does not run the CLI', () => {
238:   const res = spawnSync(
239:     process.execPath,
240:     ['-e', `import(${JSON.stringify(pathToFileURL(CLI).href)}).then(m => console.log('imported', typeof m.packContext))`],
241:     {encoding: 'utf8'},
242:   );
243:   assert.equal(res.status, 0);
244:   assert.equal(res.stderr, '');
245:   assert.equal(res.stdout.trim(), 'imported function');
246: });
